notes.title: A space adventure for quiet nights. Now with an all-new story mission update! 深夜裡的療癒星空冒險！免費故事任務重大更新
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23724258/6fe61efbba749ce12c9d7d3efa90408199764794.png[/img]

To thank you all for supporting OPUS: The Day We Found Earth, we’ve added new story missions in this latest [u][b]free update[/b][/u]!

[h1]［Awards］[/h1]
🏆 Tokyo Game Show - Sense of Wonder Night selection
🏆 Indieplay - Excellence In Audio Nomination
🏆 MomoCon - Indie Awards Finalist
🏆 TpGS Indie Game Award - Best Narration

[h1][About the Game][/h1]
A heartwarming adventure revolving around a promise. Little robot Emeth must travel through the stars, across millions of light-years, in order to fulfill the promise he made with his creator to find Earth. In the game, players will control a deep space telescope to search the unknown skies with Emeth, and perhaps find the meaning and purpose of his being along the way.

[h1][Update Contents][/h1]
This update expands upon the world of OPUS: The Day We Found Earth beyond Emeth and Lisa’s spaceship. Join them as they chase down ancient myths, and discover a different side of the galaxy. The new content includes:
[list]
[*] Faraway Home: A lost soul drifts endlessly through space, dreaming of the day it reaches home. Can you help him?
[/list]
[list]
[*] Introduction to Cosmic Myths: Doctor Lisa believes the myths in her old textbook are actual recorded history. Will Emeth be able to prove her right?
[/list]
[list]
[*] A Gift for Emeth: Emeth found a locked box left by Doctor Lisa that comes with a series of riddles. Just what lies inside?
[/list]
Additionally, each story pack is chock-full of [u][b]new music and illustrations[/b][/u] to accompany your adventures with Emeth and Lisa.

So, set off on your space journey now 👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/457680/OPUS_The_Day_We_Found_Earth/


.


《OPUS-地球計畫》回饋大家的喜愛與支持，在此次版本更新中，[u][b]免費釋出[/b][/u]全新故事任務囉！

[h1]［台灣原創遊戲・備受國際肯定］[/h1]
🏆 日本東京電玩展 Sense of Wonder Night 「官方嚴選遊戲」
🏆 TpGS「最佳敘事獎」
🏆 Indieplay 「最佳音樂音效獎」
🏆 MomoCon 「最佳獨立遊戲獎決選」

[h1][遊戲背景][/h1]
這是個關於約定的療癒故事冒險遊戲。機器人艾姆穿梭星海、跨越時光，只為實現幫助博士找到地球的約定：「艾姆跟博士約好了！」。在遊戲中，玩家將操作天文觀測望遠鏡，與艾姆一起探索未知的外太空，不畏艱難，找尋生命的價值與初衷。

[h1]［版本更新內容］[/h1]
本次的更新擴展《OPUS-地球計畫》故事範圍至奧伯斯號外的世界。艾姆與麗莎決心探索古老已如傳說的外太空，挖掘宇宙想像不到的另一面。全新的故事篇章包含：
[list]
[*] 〈遙遠的家園〉：想回家的靈魂，在宇宙中迷路千萬年，他能再見故鄉一眼嗎？
[/list]
[list]
[*] 〈宇宙神話學導論〉：麗莎博士相信古老的神話存在著史實，艾姆能替博士證明嗎？
[/list]
[list]
[*] 〈給艾姆的禮物〉：艾姆找到了麗莎博士留給他的密碼盒，裡面會有什麼等著他呢？
[/list]

此外，我們也為新的故事篇章製作了[u][b]全新的曲目與過場插畫[/b][/u]，從視覺到聽覺，滿足你太空冒險的臨場感！

現在就登上太空船出發冒險 👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/457680/OPUS_The_Day_We_Found_Earth/

notes.title: [3rd anniversary update!] A new mission is here! Meet new friends on Emeth’s journey to fulfill its promise ［三週年重大更新］新任務通知！與機器人穿梭星海實現約定
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23724258/fb1ad15c397d137b42fefd1bcbbe178af18928aa.png[/img]
It's the third anniversary of [i]OPUS: The Day We Found Earth[/i], and to thank everyone for your support, we're releasing a major update alongside a limited-time 30% discount!

[h1][b]*The Taiwanese indie game that has caught the world's attention*[/b][/h1]
🏆 Tokyo Game Show - Sense of Wonder Night selection
🏆 Indieplay - Excellence In Audio Nomination
🏆 MomoCon - Indie Awards Finalist
🏆 TpGS Indie Game Award - Best Narration

An soothing adventure story about fulfilling promises, in this game players help the little robot Emeth finish the promise made with its creator to find Earth, and save humanity. 

Emeth must scour the endless seas of space, and along the way, learn a lesson about loneliness, supporting each other, determination, and the value of life even in an age of decline.

[h1][b][Content update][/b][/h1]
- [u][b]Completely new missions and story[/b][/u]: There are more sides to the people you've know! Unveil the mysteries of the new story chapter alongside new faces and old friends.	

- [u][b]New soundtracks[/b][/u]: Acclaimed composer Triodust and soundscape master Hsu, Chia-Wei bring new masterpieces that will soothe your ears.

- [u][b]New event illustrations[/b][/u] for the story have been added to further increase the stakes of the story!

[h1][b]You can find our little cosmic story collection here ↓[/b][/h1]
[b][u]*30% discount lasts from February 26 to March 5, 2019*[/u][/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/457680/OPUS_The_Day_We_Found_Earth/ 

.

《OPUS-地球計畫》慶祝推出三週年，為回饋大家的喜愛與支持，釋出重大版本更新，並[u][b]限時特價 7 折中！[/b][/u]


[h1][b]＊台灣原創獨立遊戲・備受國際肯定＊[/b][/h1]
🏆 日本東京電玩展 Sense of Wonder Night 「官方嚴選遊戲」
🏆 TpGS「最佳敘事獎」
🏆 Indieplay 「最佳音樂音效獎」
🏆 MomoCon 「最佳獨立遊戲獎決選」


這是一款關於約定的療癒故事冒險遊戲。玩家將幫助機器人艾姆實現與其造物主「找出地球、解救人類」的約定，駕著太空船穿梭無窮星海，感受渺小一人的孤單、相互扶持的溫暖、追尋目標的決心，一同找尋萬物殞落後生命的價值。


[h1][b]［更新內容有什麼？］[/b][/h1]
- [u][b]全新任務與故事[/b][/u]：舊朋友＆新面孔登場，挖掘他們不為人知的另一面，共譜故事新篇！
- [u][b]全新曲目[/b][/u]： 由獲 Indieplay「最佳音樂音效」大獎提名的樂師 Triodust ，與金球獎紅毯典禮直播配樂的許家維共同製作，滿足你挑剔的耳朵。
- [u][b]全新過場插畫[/b][/u]：由角色們演繹故事情節，臨場感加倍！


[h1][b]現在就以七折體驗這個精緻的天文小品故事集↓ [/b][/h1]
[u][b]＊折扣時間： 2/26 至 3/5，為期 7 天 7 折中 ＊[/b][/u]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/457680/OPUS_The_Day_We_Found_Earth/

notes.title: German＆Korean languages are available in OPUS!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/DfCU5BJ.jpg[/img]
Now more gamers can play OPUS in their native language! We have just added German and Korean languages to the game. All of you make this happen. Big big thanks!

Besides, we also fixed and improved some things. We’d like to thank all of you who tracked down bugs and reported to us.

Let’s take a look at changes to version 1.7.3:

Major changes:
- German&Korean languages added to the game.

Minor changes:
- fix for crash related to clicks in the room.
- fixed issue where star report not playing properly.
- fixed some minor font issues
- stability improved!

Thank you for your amazing support!
SIGONO

tags.feature: - German&Korean languages added to the game.

tags.bug: - fix for crash related to clicks in the room.
- fixed issue where star report not playing properly.

notes.title: Update Notice
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/RkXd6xx.png[/img]
To celebrate Summer Sale, we are bringing you the latest and greatest update of the game! 
“Hyperspace Mail Order” has arrived! You can now decorate Emeth and Lisa with cool hats and skins, and embark on new side missions to explore the mystery of an unknown armor factory! All contents are free and will be unlocked after you completed the main story!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/zv5N888.png[/img]

As always, don't be afraid of getting lost in space, explore!
- SIGONO

notes.title: Update Notice
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/LlgYvBO.png[/img]
Dear fellow star gazers, 
it’s been almost a week since the launch of OPUS Steam version, we would like to thank all of you for your support, and we promise to make the game even better in the coming weeks and months.

Here are the changes to version 1.5.4
[list]
[*][STILL IN BETA] Full controller support: You can select controller mode in the options panel now, it's still in beta, so your feedbacks will be really valuable to us
[*]Redesigned Lisa Algorithm: much more eye catching now
[*]Fixed a bug where the third planet of LISA solar system won’t show up
[*]Fixed a bug causing people with 32bit PC downloading an empty game folder
[*]Lots of minor bug fixes
[/list]
Let us know how you feel about the changes, we're trying our best to be very approachable to you guys :)

- Team Signal team
